Subject: Clarify logo use + embargo in MSA/Order Form

Hi Olga,

We're finalizing the public announcement schedule for our joint pilot and have a couple of contract items to confirm before we sign the Order Form. Legal spotted the publicity clause in the MSA and the short paragraph in the draft Order Form and asked for clarity on two points:

1) Embargo window — Novacorp needs a 72-hour embargo after our customer announcement to coordinate press and partner comms. Can Redwood commit to that window in the Order Form?

2) Logo usage & reference rights — we need explicit limits around logo placement and a prohibition on case study publication without separate sign-off. Will Redwood accept a narrow, non-promotional reference right (company name + one-line description) rather than the broader testimonial language in the current MSA?

We're attaching the redline we received from our legal team (Novacorp_MSA_OrderForm_v2.pdf). If you can confirm whether Redwood agrees to the embargo and will accept the more limited reference language, we can route the updated Order Form for signature.

Thanks,
Susan

- Embargo: 72 hours is reasonable from a commercial perspective; we typically ask for a 24-48 hour courtesy but can accept 72 hours for this pilot. We'll mirror that in the Order Form.
- Reference rights: we'll need to tighten the MSA publicity language to a limited, non-promotional reference (company name + single-sentence use case) and remove broader testimonial/endorsement wording. Laura, can you propose suggested clause text and confirm this still satisfies our GTM needs?

I've uploaded our internal suggested edits to the publicity clause and a redline version for your legal team: redline_publicity_clause_vOLGA_20270822.docx. Susan, if Novacorp sends a counter-language, Laura and I can iterate and aim to exchange final redlines tomorrow.

Hi all — I reviewed Novacorp's redlines and Olga's suggested edits. Proposed final language below that should be acceptable to both legal teams. Please let me know if Novacorp wants any tweaks.

Proposed publicity clause (for insertion into the Order Form + MSA reference):
"Subject to Customer's prior written approval (not to be unreasonably withheld) and a 72-hour embargo following Customer's public announcement, Company may: (a) include Customer's name in a non-promotional customer list; (b) publish a one-paragraph case summary (no more than 150 words) describing the use of Company's services; and (c) display Customer's logo in marketing materials solely in connection with the one-paragraph case summary. Any use of Customer's logo or case summary shall be subject to Customer's prior approval of such materials, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed. No testimonials or endorsements shall be implied without separate written consent."

Key notes/operational items:
- Approval process: Customer will provide approval (or redline) within 5 business days of receipt of materials. If we don't receive approval in that window, materials will not be published.
- Logo files: please provide a vector (SVG/EPS) and brand usage guidelines. We'll only use the approved assets.
- Evidence: For public announcements tied to the Order Form, Redwood will not disclose any customer-provided confidential data (per MSA confidentiality) in the case summary.

If that is acceptable, we will update the Order Form to reflect the embargo and insert this clause into the MSA exhibit. Ben — please confirm we can operate within the 5-day sign-off SLA from marketing for approvals.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

We attach an updated, signed Order Form that reflects the 72-hour embargo and references the revised publicity clause (Novacorp_MSA_OrderForm_v2.pdf — redline accepted). Also attaching our logo kit (novacorp_logo_v3.zip).

If Redwood accepts the two edits (7-day SLA + 30-day revocation right), we can sign the MSA exhibit and finalize.
